entities.name: Fall of the Numena
entities.description: The event ending the Numena's thousand-year rule of Dominaria, when they destroyed Karona and lost their power and lives.

entities.name: Numena
entities.description: Rulers of Dominaria for a thousand years toward the end of Mythohistory.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: Numena who conspired to kill the white and green Numena.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: Numena who set a resurrection spell and started a war to power it.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: Numena who conspired against the white and green Numena.

entities.name: King Themeus
entities.description: King toppled by the three Numena.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Living incarnation of magic itself, called Mother, born of the Numena's conflict and destroyed after thirteen months.

events.summary: Kuberr, Averru and Lowallyn conspire to kill the white and green Numena and topple King Themeus.
events.quote: Kuberr , Averru , and Lowallyn conspired together to overthrow and kill the white and the green Numena

events.summary: Averru sets a resurrection spell and starts a war with the other two to power it.
events.quote: Averru set up a spell that would eventually resurrect himself

events.summary: The Numena's conflict accidentally gives birth to Karona, living incarnation of magic.
events.quote: their powers accidentally gave birth to the being they called Mother

events.summary: The Numena destroy Karona, at the cost of their power and lives.
events.quote: Karona existed for only thirteen months before the Numena managed to destroy her

relations.quote: Karona existed for only thirteen months before the Numena managed to destroy her
